hero.subtitleOld: Organize and standardize construction tasks through construction templates, automatic schedules and visual tracking
hero.description: GROWS is a B2B digital platform designed for architecture studios, independent architects and small construction companies dedicated to small and medium-scale works.

problem.title: The problem in construction
problem.subtitle: Informal methods and lack of adequate tools

informal.title: Informal methods
informal.description: Small and medium-scale residential works usually operate with informal methods, absence of systematic planning and lack of reliable records.

tools.title: Lack of tools
tools.description: Existing platforms are oriented to large construction companies, leaving architecture studios and small construction companies without specific tools.

consequences.title: Consequences
consequences.description: This situation generates conflicts, cost overruns and low productivity in works.

solution.title: The GROWS solution
solution.subtitle: Centralized and efficient management for Technical Clients
solution.description: GROWS covers this gap by offering a B2B digital solution that allows Technical Clients to manage, assign and control their crew leaders in a centralized and efficient way.

templates.title: Construction Templates
templates.description: Predefined and standardized tasks for each construction phase

tracking.title: Visual Tracking
tracking.description: Real-time control of the progress of each task

centralized.title: Centralized Management
centralized.description: One place to manage all your works and crews

users.title: Each role works in a digital environment
users.description: Grows connects leaders and executors visually, clearly and precisely.
